gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Press Start 2P spaces its chunky, retro letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with only a faint thick-to-thin shift. Noto Sans Grantha is the quieter partner, a plain sans whose tall little letters never snag on a closed-up bowl.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Pixel-bright and playfully retro, Press Start 2P goes first with big open lowercase bowls. And Noto Sans Gujarati keeps a long read smooth, its curved strokes stopping short of turning inward.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-: Retro and cheeky, with letters spaced like cut-outs. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi settles a long read down, its crayon-tall lowercase and cut-back terminals leaving gaps that keep Press Start 2P's fun from tiring the eye.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Press Start 2P brings fun, retro letters with a mellow swing from thick to thin, spaced far apart like pinned cut-outs. Noto Sans Gurmukhi, with outward-pointing terminals, is the tidy counterweight.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line's height with open-ended lowercase. Over a long passage it reads smoothly and plainly, leaving Press Start 2P's retro, far-apart letters to supply all the fun above it.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Letters spaced like cut-outs pinned far apart mark Press Start 2P. Make that heading small and the pixel charm shrinks, while Noto Sans Hebrew's dominant midsection and wide curve gaps stay easy to take in.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-hk: Press Start 2P has big open-looking lowercase bowls and hairlines just slightly thinner than its stems, giving it a retro grin. Enlarge Noto Sans HK a touch, since its tight ascenders sit snug.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-imperial: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P sets its big lowercase bowls far apart, with moderate thick-thin shifts. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic feels approachable beside it, its open-pincer c a friendly foil.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-inscript: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P spaces its letters like pinned cut-outs, with gently modulated strokes. And Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian carries a long read easily, big open eyes on every e and a.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP has a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open instead of curling shut. Noto Sans JP sits quietly under Press Start 2P, letting the heading's retro, far-apart letters have all the fun.
